card.name: Spots where 'of' or 'de' comes next
card.fires_on: Nouns, or the end of a long word, right before a likely 'of' or Spanish 'de/del' (e.g. 'Line' before 'of Control', 'Colegio' before 'de la'). Seen mostly in Spanish text and in place names.

modes.label: Spanish noun before de
modes.description: Spanish nouns or word endings where 'de' or 'del' is expected next.
modes.example: of El Cole<<gio>> de la Frontera

modes.label: English noun before of
modes.description: An English noun in a named phrase where 'of' is expected next.
modes.example: drawn at the<< Line>> of Control, but the region of Kashmir

modes.label: Medical word endings
modes.description: The end of a medical term or noun that tends to be followed by a linking word.
modes.example: (En español: Nefropat<<ía>>) Having diabetes for many years

card.writes: It favors Spanish and Italian 'del/della' and discourages 'of' and its equivalents, so it shifts the next word away from 'of'.
card.plain: It fires on a word when the next word is likely to be 'de' or 'of', mostly in Spanish text.
